# Data

## Load and explore

Load data from Terzin paper

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data.path.terzin1 = file.path("..","DataSources","SeawaterMicrobes_Terzin1","Terzin1_data.rds")
input_data.terzin1 = readRDS(data.path.terzin1)
taxa_terzin1 = input_data.terzin1$taxa_MINT
GO_terzin1 = input_data.terzin1$GO_MINT
continuous_env_terzin1 = as.matrix(input_data.terzin1$continuous_env_MINT_sPLS)
study.terzin1 = input_data.terzin1$sample_metadata$Sampling_trip
```

Exploration of sample metadata

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
table(input_data.terzin1$sample_metadata$Sampling_trip, input_data.terzin1$sample_metadata$GBR_sector)
```

## Filter, tidy up, and select

Extra pre-processing due to variables with constant values

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## check taxa features
taxa_terzin1.var.check <- do.call(rbind,
                                 lapply(unique(study.terzin1),function(x){apply(taxa_terzin1[study.terzin1==x,], 2, FUN = "var", na.rm = TRUE)})
)
mean(colSums(taxa_terzin1.var.check==0)==0)
taxa_terzin1 <- taxa_terzin1[,colSums(taxa_terzin1.var.check==0)==0]

## check GO term features
GO_terzin1.var.check <- do.call(rbind,
                                 lapply(unique(study.terzin1),function(x){apply(GO_terzin1[study.terzin1==x,], 2, FUN = "var", na.rm = TRUE)})
)
mean(colSums(GO_terzin1.var.check==0)==0)
GO_terzin1 <- GO_terzin1[,colSums(GO_terzin1.var.check==0)==0]

## check environmental features
continuous_env_terzin1.var.check <- do.call(rbind,
                                 lapply(unique(study.terzin1),function(x){apply(continuous_env_terzin1[study.terzin1==x,], 2, FUN = "var", na.rm = TRUE)})
)
mean(colSums(continuous_env_terzin1.var.check==0)==0)
continuous_env_terzin1 <- continuous_env_terzin1[,colSums(continuous_env_terzin1.var.check==0)==0]

```

Tidy up taxa variable names and metadata

```{r}
# extract metadata as a data frame
taxa_metadata <- as.data.frame(input_data.terzin1$taxa_metadata)

# ensure alignment
taxa_metadata <- taxa_metadata[colnames(taxa_terzin1),]

# save old ids
taxa_metadata$original_id <- rownames(taxa_metadata)

# how granular are the groupings?
apply(taxa_metadata,2,function(x){
  print(length(unique(x)))
})

# new grouping variable starting from most to least granular
taxa_groups <- c('Species', 'Genus', 'Family', 'Order', 'Class', 'Phylum', 'Domain')
new_group_null <- "NA"
taxa_metadata$new_group <- new_group_null
for (taxa_group in taxa_groups){
  taxa_metadata$new_group[taxa_metadata$new_group==new_group_null] <- paste0(substr(taxa_group,1,1),"_",taxa_metadata[taxa_metadata$new_group==new_group_null,taxa_group])
  new_group_null <- paste0(substr(taxa_group,1,1),"_NA")
}

# add informative grouping variable and old_id to create new_id
taxa_metadata$new_id <- paste0(taxa_metadata$original_id,"_",taxa_metadata$new_group)

# remove any commas
taxa_metadata$new_id <- gsub(",",";",taxa_metadata$new_id) 

# change row and column names
rownames(taxa_metadata) <- taxa_metadata$new_id
colnames(taxa_terzin1) <- rownames(taxa_metadata)

```

Tidy up GO variable names and metadata

```{r}
# create standalone metadata table
GO_metadata <- as.data.frame(input_data.terzin1$GO_metadata)

# ensure alignment
GO_metadata <- GO_metadata[colnames(GO_terzin1),]

# save old ids
GO_metadata$original_id <- rownames(GO_metadata)

# select a GO term and IPR term for each row
GO_metadata$GO_term <- NA
GO_metadata$IPR_term <- NA
term_ranks <- c("Rank5", "Rank4", "Rank3")
for (term_rank in term_ranks){
  
  # update GO term
  require_GO <- is.na(GO_metadata$GO_term)
  suitable_for_GO <- substr(GO_metadata[,term_rank],1,2)=="GO"
  suitable_for_GO[is.na(suitable_for_GO)] = FALSE
  GO_metadata$GO_term[require_GO & suitable_for_GO] <- GO_metadata[require_GO & suitable_for_GO,term_rank]
  
  # update IPR term
  require_IPR <- is.na(GO_metadata$IPR_term)
  suitable_for_IPR <- substr(GO_metadata[,term_rank],1,3)=="IPR"
  suitable_for_IPR[is.na(suitable_for_IPR)] = FALSE
  GO_metadata$IPR_term[require_IPR & suitable_for_IPR] <- GO_metadata[require_IPR & suitable_for_IPR,term_rank]
}

# add informative grouping variable and old_id to create new_id
GO_metadata$new_id <- GO_metadata$IPR_term
GO_metadata$new_id[is.na(GO_metadata$new_id)] <- GO_metadata$GO_term[is.na(GO_metadata$new_id)]
GO_metadata$new_id <- paste0(GO_metadata$original_id,"_",GO_metadata$new_id)

# remove any commas
GO_metadata$new_id <- gsub(",",";",GO_metadata$new_id) 

# change row and column names
rownames(GO_metadata) <- GO_metadata$new_id
colnames(GO_terzin1) <- rownames(GO_metadata)

```

Tidy up environmental variable names

```{r}
colnames(continuous_env_terzin1) <- gsub("median_","",colnames(continuous_env_terzin1))
```

Select data for Analysis

```{r}
fit_data = list(taxonomic = taxa_terzin1, functional = GO_terzin1, environmental = continuous_env_terzin1)
sample.study = study.terzin1
studies <- unique(sample.study)
```

Check how many variables and observations

```{r}
lapply(fit_data,function(x){dim(x)})
```


## Unwanted variation adjustment

ComBat adjusted data

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
fit_data.combat = lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(ComBat(t(x), batch = sample.study))
})
```

RBE adjusted data

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
fit_data.RBE = lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(removeBatchEffect(t(x), batch = sample.study))
})
```


## Unwanted variation in raw data

Get PCs for each block

```{r}
fit.pca <- lapply(names(fit_data), function(block){
    PCA <- mixOmics::pca(X = fit_data[[block]], ncomp = 2, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)$variates$X
    PCA <- as.data.frame(scale(PCA))
    PCA$block <- block
    PCA$Trip <- as.factor(substr(sample.study,6,nchar(sample.study)))
    return(PCA)
})

fit.pca <- do.call(rbind,fit.pca)
```

Plot to examine unwanted variation

```{r}
ggplot(fit.pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Trip)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major=element_blank()
    , strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    , axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    # , axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    , axis.text = element_blank()
    , axis.ticks = element_blank()
    , legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
    , legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    # ,legend.position="none"
    ) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
  scale_color_manual(values = my_Set1)

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 

```


# Benchmarking with all data

## Choose inputs

```{r}
# will use number of components and variables per component same as the article - tuning prior to deep dive
ncomp <- 2
keepX <- list(taxonomic=c(50,50), functional=c(50,50))
studies <- unique(sample.study)
indY <- 3
mode <- 'regression'
```

## Fit using all data

```{r}
fit.block.spls.full = block.spls(X = fit_data, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
fit.block.spls.combat.full = block.spls(X = fit_data.combat, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
fit.block.spls.RBE.full = block.spls(X = fit_data.RBE, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
fit.mint.block.spls.full = mint.block.spls(X = fit_data, indY = indY, study=sample.study, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
```

## Quantitative measures of spread

```{r}
fits <- list(
  "Block_spls" = fit.block.spls.full,
  "Block_spls_combat" = fit.block.spls.combat.full,
  "Block_spls_rbe" = fit.block.spls.RBE.full,
  "MINT Block_spls" = fit.mint.block.spls.full
)
```

# Benchmark using subsets

## Fit models 

block.spls on raw data

```{r}
fit.block.spls = sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain = !is.element(sample.study,x)
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  fit = block.spls(X = fit_data.train, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.spls on combat adjusted data (each training dataset adjusted independently)

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.spls.combat = sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain = !is.element(sample.study,x)
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){
    t(ComBat(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain]))
    })
  fit = block.spls(X = fit_data.train, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.spls on RBE adjusted data (each training dataset adjusted independently)

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.spls.RBE = sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain = !is.element(sample.study,x)
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){
    t(removeBatchEffect(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain]))
    })
  fit = block.spls(X = fit_data.train, indY = indY, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

mint.block.spls fit

```{r}
fit.mint.block.spls = sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain = !is.element(sample.study,x)
  sample.study.train = sample.study[InTrain]
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  fit = mint.block.spls(X = fit_data.train, indY = indY, study = sample.study.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, mode = mode)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```


## Extract features and compare stability across subsets

Extract and plot for all fits

```{r}
fits = list(
  "Block_spls" = fit.block.spls,
  "Block_spls_combat" = fit.block.spls.combat,
  "Block_spls_rbe" = fit.block.spls.RBE,
  "MINT Block_spls" = fit.mint.block.spls
)

#####
# stability using all components
####

selection_frequency_th <- length(fits[[1]]) * (1/2)
# features selected in > selection_frequency_th studies put in the 'more' group

fit.feature.props = extract.fit.feature.props(
  fits = fits, 
  blocks = c("taxonomic", "functional"), 
  selection_frequency_th = selection_frequency_th,
  begin_comp = 1,
  end_comp = ncomp
  )


# plot the feature selection proportions by fit and block and frequency
ggplot(fit.feature.props) + 
  geom_col(aes(x = selection_frequency, y = proportion_of_features, fill = fit), position = 'dodge') + 
  labs(
    x = "Selection frequency",
    y = "Proportion of variables"
    ) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")+
  labs(fill = "Fit")

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'stability_all.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'stability_all.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 

# print proportion of features selected across all fits

print(
  fit.feature.props[fit.feature.props$selection_frequency==max(fit.feature.props$selection_frequency),]
)

# print proportions by frequency group

fit.feature.props.group <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit, selection_frequency_group) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion_of_features)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.group$proportion <- round(fit.feature.props.group$proportion,2)

print(fit.feature.props.group)

# print weighted stability score by block and model

fit.feature.props.global <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit) %>%
  summarise(ave_freq = sum(wghtd_freq)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.global$stability <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq / length(studies),2)
fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq,2)

print(fit.feature.props.global)

```


# In depth analysis with MINT Block

## Tune number of components

```{r}
ncomp <- 4

tuned.mint.block.pls = tune.mint.block.pls(
  X = fit_data,
  indY = indY,
  ncomp = ncomp,
  mode = mode,
  study = sample.study
)
```


Print the suggested number of components

```{r}
print(tuned.mint.block.pls$loocv.ncomp$choice.ncomp)
print(tuned.mint.block.pls$loocv.ncomp$choice.ncomp.study)
```

Plot the Q2 values

```{r}
plot.df <- tuned.mint.block.pls$loocv.ncomp$Q2.study[[names(fit_data[indY])]]
plot.df$Trip <- plot.df$study
ggplot(plot.df, aes(x = comp, y = Q2, color = Trip)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tuned.mint.block.pls$loocv.ncomp$limQ2, color="red", linetype="dashed") +
  stat_summary(geom="line", fun = "mean", color="black", linetype="dashed") +
  stat_summary(geom="point", fun = "mean", color="black") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_Set1)

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'ncomp.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'ncomp.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
```

Plot the MPSE values

```{r}
plot.df <- tuned.mint.block.pls$loocv.ncomp$MPSE.study[[names(fit_data[indY])]]
ggplot(plot.df, aes(x = comp, y = MPSE, color = study)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_summary(geom="line", fun = "mean", color="black", linetype="dashed") +
  stat_summary(geom="point", fun = "mean", color="black") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    )+
  scale_color_manual(values = my_Set1)
```

## Plots

### Global variates coloured by batch

```{r}

variates.global <- sapply(names(fit.mint.block.spls.full$variates), function(block){
  block.variates <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.spls.full$variates[[block]])
  block.variates$block <- block
  block.variates$Batch <- fit.mint.block.spls.full$study
  block.variates$Trip <- as.factor(substr(as.character(fit.mint.block.spls.full$study),6,nchar(as.character(fit.mint.block.spls.full$study))))
  return(block.variates)
},simplify = FALSE,USE.NAMES = TRUE)

variates.global <- do.call('rbind',variates.global)
```

Calculate correlations between global variates

```{r}
variates.global <- sapply(names(fit.mint.block.spls.full$variates), function(block){
  block.variates <- fit.mint.block.spls.full$variates[[block]]
  colnames(block.variates) <- paste0(block,'_',colnames(block.variates))
  return(block.variates)
},simplify = FALSE,USE.NAMES = TRUE)

variates.global <- do.call('cbind',variates.global)

variates.global.cor <- round(cor(variates.global),2)

print(variates.global.cor)
```

### Heatmaps of correlations

Select variables to plot

```{r}
ndisplay <- 25
taxonomic_select_comp <- vector("list")
functional_select_comp <- vector("list")
environmental_select_comp <- vector("list")

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
  
  # select features form each block
  
  taxonomic_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$taxonomic[,comp_to_plot]))
  # taxonomic_select <- fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$taxonomic[,comp_to_plot]!=0
  taxonomic_select <- (fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$taxonomic[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (taxonomic_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  functional_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$functional[,comp_to_plot]))
  # functional_select <- fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$functional[,comp_to_plot]!=0
  functional_select <- (fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$functional[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (functional_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  environmental_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$environmental[,comp_to_plot]))
  # environmental_select <- fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$environmental[,comp_to_plot]!=0
  environmental_select <- (fit.mint.block.spls.full$loadings$environmental[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (environmental_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  # save for the component
  taxonomic_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- taxonomic_select
  functional_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- functional_select
  environmental_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- environmental_select
  
}
```


Use the network function to get the correlations between features

```{r}
# network function with no cutoff to get the correlation matrix and all edges
fit.network.all <- network(fit.mint.block.spls.full,
        blocks = c(1,2,3),
        cutoff = 0,
        color.node = my_Paired[c(10,11,4)],
        save = 'png', name.save = file.path(plot_folder,'diablo-network-all')
        )
```

Extract the correlation matrix and plot with a heatmap

```{r}
# just correlations with the environmental vars for now
# check alignment
colnames(fit.network.all$M_taxonomic_environmental) == colnames(fit.network.all$M_functional_environmental)

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
  
  cor_Mat <- rbind(fit.network.all$M_taxonomic_environmental,fit.network.all$M_functional_environmental)
  #remove rownames suffix
  suffixes <- paste0("_",names(fit_data))
  for (suffix in suffixes){
    # remove from 'from' column
    if_remove <- substr(rownames(cor_Mat), nchar(rownames(cor_Mat)) - nchar(suffix) + 1, nchar(rownames(cor_Mat))) == suffix
    rownames(cor_Mat)[if_remove] <- substr(rownames(cor_Mat)[if_remove], 1, nchar(rownames(cor_Mat)[if_remove]) - nchar(suffix))
    
    # remove from 'to' column
    if_remove <- substr(colnames(cor_Mat), nchar(colnames(cor_Mat)) - nchar(suffix) + 1, nchar(colnames(cor_Mat))) == suffix
    colnames(cor_Mat)[if_remove] <- substr(colnames(cor_Mat)[if_remove], 1, nchar(colnames(cor_Mat)[if_remove]) - nchar(suffix))
  }
  
  # filter to include those for the component
  cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[is.element(rownames(cor_Mat),
                                c(names(taxonomic_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[taxonomic_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
                                  names(functional_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[functional_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
                                  names(environmental_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[environmental_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]])
                                ),]
  cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[,is.element(colnames(cor_Mat),
                                 c(names(taxonomic_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[taxonomic_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
                                  names(functional_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[functional_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]],
                                  names(environmental_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[environmental_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]])
                                 )]
  
  # get metadata
  metadata_cor_Mat <- data.frame(
  variable_id = c(taxa_metadata$new_id, GO_metadata$new_id),
  block = c(rep("taxonomic",length(taxa_metadata$new_id)), rep("functional",length(GO_metadata$new_id)))
  # ,group = c(taxa_metadata$Domain, GO_metadata$Rank2)
  )
  # metadata_cor_Mat$group <- paste0(metadata_cor_Mat$block,"_",metadata_cor_Mat$group)
  rownames(metadata_cor_Mat) <- metadata_cor_Mat$variable_id
  metadata_cor_Mat <- metadata_cor_Mat[rownames(cor_Mat),]
  
  
  # set annotation colours for the plot
  metadata_cor_annotation <- data.frame(
      block = as.factor(metadata_cor_Mat$block)
      # ,group = as.factor(metadata_cor_Mat$group)
    )
  rownames(metadata_cor_annotation) <- rownames(cor_Mat)
  
  annot_colors <- list(
    block  = my_Paired[c(10, 11)]
    # ,group = my_Set3[1:nlevels(metadata_cor_annotation$group)]
    )
  
  names(annot_colors$block) <- levels(metadata_cor_annotation$block)
  # names(annot_colors$group) <- levels(metadata_cor_annotation$group)
  
  # plot
    
  hm_cor <- pheatmap(
      # mat = t(cor_Mat),
      # annotation_col = MAGs_annotation,
      # annotation_row = environmental_annotation,
      mat = cor_Mat,
      annotation_row = metadata_cor_annotation,
      # annotation_col = environmental_annotation,
      border_color = NA,
      cellwidth = 20,
      cellheight = 20,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = TRUE,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      fontsize = 14,
      angle_col = "45",
      treeheight_row = 0,
      treeheight_col = 0,
      annotation_colors = annot_colors
    )
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_comp",comp_to_plot,".pdf")), 
         plot = hm_cor[[4]],
         width = 40, height = 40, units = "cm")
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_comp",comp_to_plot,".png")), 
         plot = hm_cor[[4]],
         width = 40, height = 40, units = "cm")

}
```
